panels.title: Overview

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  (SELECT count(DISTINCT "user") FROM usages WHERE "createdAt" > x.now - interval '24 hours') AS "Users, 24 h",
  (SELECT count(DISTINCT "user") FROM usages WHERE "createdAt" > x.now - interval '30 days') AS "Users, 30 days",
  (SELECT count(*) FROM usages WHERE "createdAt" > x.now - interval '24 hours') AS "Commands, 24 h",
  (SELECT round(count(*)::numeric / nullif(count(DISTINCT "user"), 0), 2)
     FROM usages WHERE "createdAt" > x.now - interval '48 hours') AS "Commands per user, 48 h",
  (SELECT count(DISTINCT guild) FROM usages WHERE "createdAt" > x.now - interval '7 days') AS "Servers, 7 days",
  (SELECT count(*) FROM blvotes WHERE list = 0 AND "createdAt" > x.now - interval '30 days') AS "top.gg votes, 30 days"
FROM (SELECT (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS now) x

panels.description: Users and servers that ran a slash command (usages). Plays from panels, buttons and entrance sounds are in the Plays row.

panels.title: Daily active users and commands

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("createdAt", 1d, 0), count(*) AS "commands", count(DISTINCT "user") AS "active users"
FROM usages
WHERE $__timeFilter("createdAt")
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Slash commands per UTC day, and the people who ran them.

panels.title: Commands per day

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("createdAt", 1d, 0), command AS metric, count(*) AS value
FROM usages
WHERE $__timeFilter("createdAt")
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Slash commands per UTC day, by top-level command name.

panels.title: New uploads per day

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("createdAt", 1d, 0), count(*) AS "uploads", count(DISTINCT "user") AS "uploaders"
FROM sound_commands
WHERE $__timeFilter("createdAt")
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Sounds that still exist, by upload day. Deleted sounds are gone from this count.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("createdAt", 1d, 0), count(*) AS "likes"
FROM likes
WHERE $__timeFilter("createdAt")
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: top.gg votes per day

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("createdAt", 1d, 0), count(*) AS "votes"
FROM blvotes
WHERE list = 0 AND $__timeFilter("createdAt")
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Votes received through the top.gg webhook. None arrived from March to October 2026 while the webhook was broken.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT "user" AS "User ID", count(*) AS "Commands"
FROM usages
WHERE "createdAt" > (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - interval '48 hours'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC
LIMIT 5

panels.title: Features (v5.0)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 'Soundboard panels' AS "Feature", count(DISTINCT guild) AS "Servers", count(*) AS "Items" FROM soundboard_panels
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Entrance sounds', count(DISTINCT guild), count(*) FROM entrance_sounds
UNION ALL
SELECT f.feature, f.servers, NULL FROM (
  SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE "leaveAfterPlay") AS leave,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT "sendMessageAfterPlay") AS silent,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT "entranceSounds") AS no_entrance
  FROM guild_settings
) g CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES
  ('Leave after play', g.leave),
  ('No message after play', g.silent),
  ('Entrance sounds turned off', g.no_entrance)
) f(feature, servers)

panels.description: Servers using each setting. Items is the number of panels or entrance sounds.

panels.title: House rules (v5.1)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT f.feature AS "Rule", f.servers AS "Servers", NULL::bigint AS "Items" FROM (
  SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE "playRole" IS NOT NULL) AS play_role,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE "quietStart" IS NOT NULL AND "quietEnd" IS NOT NULL AND "quietStart" <> "quietEnd") AS quiet,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE "serverSoundsOnly") AS own_sounds,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE "maxSoundSeconds" IS NOT NULL) AS max_length
  FROM guild_settings
) g CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES
  ('Play role', g.play_role),
  ('Quiet hours', g.quiet),
  ('Server sounds only', g.own_sounds),
  ('Max sound length', g.max_length)
) f(feature, servers)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Blocked sounds', count(DISTINCT guild), count(*) FROM blocked_sounds
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Entrance sounds: ' || kind, count(DISTINCT guild), count(*) FROM entrance_sounds GROUP BY kind

panels.description: Needs the v5.1 migration (house-rule columns, blocked_sounds, entrance kinds); shows an error until it has run.

panels.title: Plays (v5.1 plays table; earlier days come from /play and /random in usages)
Plays, 24 h

targets.rawSql:
WITH since AS (SELECT coalesce((SELECT "createdAt" FROM plays ORDER BY id LIMIT 1), 'infinity') AS first_play),
recent AS (
  SELECT "user" FROM plays WHERE "createdAt" > (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - interval '24 hours'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT u."user" FROM usages u, since
  WHERE u.command IN ('play', 'random') AND u."createdAt" > (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - interval '24 hours' AND u."createdAt" < since.first_play
)
SELECT count(*) AS "Plays", count(DISTINCT "user") AS "Players" FROM recent

panels.description: Started playbacks from every source (commands, panels, buttons, entrance sounds) and the people who started them.

panels.title: Plays per day by source

targets.rawSql:
WITH since AS (SELECT coalesce((SELECT "createdAt" FROM plays ORDER BY id LIMIT 1), 'infinity') AS first_play)
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(t, 1d, 0), metric, count(*) AS value
FROM (
  SELECT "createdAt" AS t, source AS metric FROM plays WHERE $__timeFilter("createdAt")
  UNION ALL
  SELECT u."createdAt", 'command (from usages)' FROM usages u, since
  WHERE u.command IN ('play', 'random') AND u."createdAt" < since.first_play AND $__timeFilter(u."createdAt")
) p
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Days before the first row in plays count /play and /random commands instead (commands only, no panel or entrance plays).

targets.rawSql:
WITH since AS (SELECT coalesce((SELECT "createdAt" FROM plays ORDER BY id LIMIT 1), 'infinity') AS first_play),
play_args AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN u.args IS JSON OBJECT THEN u.args::jsonb ->> 'sound' END AS v
  FROM usages u, since
  WHERE u.command = 'play' AND u."createdAt" > (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - interval '7 days' AND u."createdAt" < since.first_play
),
recent AS (
  SELECT "soundId" AS id FROM plays WHERE "createdAt" > (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - interval '7 days'
  UNION ALL
  -- /play logs the sound id since v5 and the sound name before
  SELECT CASE WHEN v ~ '^[0-9]{1,9}$' THEN v::int END FROM play_args
  UNION ALL
  SELECT s.id FROM play_args a JOIN sound_commands s ON s.name = a.v WHERE a.v !~ '^[0-9]{1,9}$'
)
SELECT s.name AS "Sound", count(*) AS "Plays, 7 days", s.uses AS "Plays, all time"
FROM recent r JOIN sound_commands s ON s.id = r.id
GROUP BY s.id
ORDER BY 2 DESC, 3 DESC
LIMIT 15

panels.title: Top servers by plays, 7 days

targets.rawSql:
WITH since AS (SELECT coalesce((SELECT "createdAt" FROM plays ORDER BY id LIMIT 1), 'infinity') AS first_play),
recent AS (
  SELECT guild, "user" FROM plays WHERE "createdAt" > (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - interval '7 days'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT u.guild, u."user" FROM usages u, since
  WHERE u.command IN ('play', 'random') AND u.guild IS NOT NULL
    AND u."createdAt" > (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - interval '7 days' AND u."createdAt" < since.first_play
)
SELECT guild AS "Server ID", count(*) AS "Plays", count(DISTINCT "user") AS "Players"
FROM recent
GROUP BY guild
ORDER BY 2 DESC
LIMIT 15

panels.description: Server names aren't stored; look an ID up in Discord.

panels.title: Sounds

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS "Sounds",
       sum(size) AS "Storage",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE uses = 0 AND "createdAt" < (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - interval '1 year') AS "Never played, over a year old",
       coalesce(sum(size) FILTER (WHERE uses = 0 AND "createdAt" < (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - interval '1 year'), 0) AS "Their storage",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE duration < 2) AS "Without duration"
FROM sound_commands

panels.description: Counted from sound_commands rows, so stray files on disk without a row are not included. Without duration: the length couldn't be read at upload (v4 sounds).

panels.title: Sounds by week last played

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("lastUsedAt", 7d, 0), count(*) AS "sounds"
FROM sound_commands
WHERE $__timeFilter("lastUsedAt")
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.description: How many sounds were last played in each week. A new upload counts as played.
